name: SexWithPlayer
description: Initiate a sex scene with the player.
note: Replaces the Mantella Community Resources - ostim action of the same name. Offered only to NPCs close to you (decided by the Hub). Handled by this module, which asks the player first; the file name stays so the Community Resources action is replaced.

source.description: The NPC initiating the sex scene.

target.description: The player character receiving the action.

prompt:
ANIMATION TRIGGER: starts a sex scene with the player. Use it when the player clearly asks for sex now or clearly agrees to it, or when an event says sex is starting. The player then answers a yes or no box, so a clear yes in conversation is enough. Do not use it for flirting, for talk about sex some other time, or while a scene is already running.

If it applies, begin your response with '{key}:'.
